question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'pampered'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• ***Treated-** *to behave towards someone or deal with something in a particular way (किसी के प्रति व्यवहार करना या किसी विशेष तरीके से व्यवहार करना)
 
• ***Prepared-** *ready to deal with a situation स्थिति से निपटने के लिए तैयार
 
• ***Trained-** *having been prepared for a particular job or activity, by learning skills, getting qualifications, etc. कौशल सीखने, योग्यता प्राप्त करने आदि के द्वारा किसी विशेष कार्य या गतिविधि के लिए तैयार किया जाना।
 
• ***Pampered-** *given special treatment that makes you feel as comfortable as possible or gives you whatever you want विशेष उपचार दिया गया है जो आपको यथासंभव सहज महसूस कराता है या आपको वह देता है जो आप चाहते हैं
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. Pampered.**

*Now the passage will be read as:- Long ago in China, at a time when girls (1) were__ expected to stay at home and (2) __do__ household work while the boys (3) __went__ to school, a girl named Zhu had a desire (4) __to__ study. Her family was wealthy and Zhu was **(5) __pampered__ **so she too could have had her wish, but her father did not want to go against tradition.*
